keys.name: roster
doc: extra subagent roles the guards should know, as role: engineer | critic (CS-39).
The built-in roster (the kit's own agent names) needs no entry. A role that is not on the roster is treated
as an engineer (agent-blind default); a `<plugin>:` prefix on agent_type is stripped before matching.

keys.name: protected_branches
doc: branches that are shared: no edits to app source while checked out, no push, no force-delete, no hard-reset onto them.
main and master are always protected, whatever this says.

keys.name: integration_branch
doc: the loop's integration branch, if you use one (DEC-2). Protected like main. Empty = none.

keys.name: main_edit_allow
doc: extra path globs that may be edited while on a protected branch (repo-relative, `**` crosses directories).
Built in: docs/**, plan files, README/CHANGELOG/GLOSSARY/LICENSE/.gitignore, CLAUDE.md and .claude/context/**.
There is no allow-list for the rest of .claude/** (report section 7.1).
